acquisition: Tian et al. 2014 inert resolution target; 293 numbered TIFFs. Assumed acquisition assignment follows the author natural-sort singleton example and authentic chart mask. Actual per-exposure control logs, flux monitors and blank/dark calibration unavailable.
evaluation_unit: unweighted mean squared Euclidean shape error across 98 preregistered, disjoint opposed pairs; single chart/session. Include every pair and summarize per-pair worst with both raw, normalized and control values. No pooled pixel confidence interval.
out_of_scope: Absolute intensity, hardware component inference, uniform irradiance, repeat trials, acquisition-time ordering, and synthetic or missing simultaneous-light measurements.

primary_roi.selection: fixed central 256 square, using the released SystemSetup.m center row1080 col1280. No registration, translation or rescaling.

primary_shape: Subtract one spatial mean, divide by Euclidean norm over all 65536 ROI pixels separately per image. Target transformation belongs only to scorer. A constant image maps to all zero and remains in primary aggregate, with count disclosed; nonconstant shape error is Euclidean distance of unit vectors.
separate_multiplex_endpoint: not scored; corresponding second stack and random realization unbound
source_indexing: i=1..293 is column-major order over LitCoord<9.5 (h0=14,v0=13), counterpart 294-i. Numeric file index records the assignment. Central camera ROI can have finite off-axis mismatch.
source_only_diagnostics: Check source identity and direction-dependent diversity, zero/dynamic range or constant/clipping path, recorded opposing-pair residuals and strongest same-information interpolation. Candidate and complete controls will freeze after source diagnostics and before held pixels; no held-selection changes.
status: prospective source/held membership before any pixels
